scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “Relative generation and the generator problem for finite factors” (preprints/Relative-generation-and-the-generator-problem-for-finite-factors-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 296 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c5838d4e6aba1dc1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every II1 factor with separable predual is generated by four self-adjoint elements.
